description: WORKER (playhq-worker/src/index.ts): make the competition sweep record PER-GRADE. Stamp grade_id + grade_name onto swept appearances (alongside the existing season_id), rewrite updateSweepLog to upsert ONE playhq_sweep_log row per (season_id, grade_id) with a distinct player count filtered by grade, and update GET /api/sweep-log to return the new columns. Only the SWEEP ingest path is touched; REST/live/backfill paths stay byte-for-byte unchanged. This feature defines the /api/sweep-log field shape that FEAT-002 consumes, so it comes first.
steps: In ingestPlayers (~L2348, signature ingestPlayers(summary, env, seasonId?)) add two optional params: gradeId?: string, gradeName?: string (default undefined). Where appearanceRows is built (currently `const appearanceRows = seasonId ? appearances.map(a => ({ ...a, season_id: seasonId })) : appearances;`), extend the sweep-path mapping so that when seasonId is present each row also gets grade_id and grade_name, but ONLY for keys that are defined (build a small overlay object: always include season_id; conditionally add grade_id when gradeId != null and grade_name when gradeName != null; spread it onto the row). The no-seasonId branch (REST/live/backfill) must stay EXACTLY `appearances` so those rows are byte-for-byte unchanged (no grade keys). Keep the on_conflict=player_id,game_id upsert unchanged.

In runSweepBatch (~L2454, signature runSweepBatch(gradeShortId, offset, limit, env, seasonId?)) add a trailing optional param gradeName?: string. Change its single ingest call to `await ingestPlayers(summary, env, seasonId, gradeShortId, gradeName)` — gradeShortId is the grade id. Leave the throttle short-circuit return and all other logic unchanged.

In the /api/admin/sweep-competition handler (~L2782), update the runSweepBatch call (~L2876) from `runSweepBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env, resolved.season.id)` to also pass the grade NAME as the final arg: `runSweepBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env, resolved.season.id, grades[gradeIndex].name)`. gradeId is already grades[gradeIndex].id.

REWRITE updateSweepLog (~L2538) to be PER GRADE. Change signature to updateSweepLog(env, resolved, seasonId, gradeId, gradeName). Compute the distinct player count for THIS grade: `const rows = await sbGet(env, `playhq_player_appearances?select=player_id&season_id=eq.${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}&grade_id=eq.${encodeURIComponent(gradeId)}&limit=50000`);` then `const count = new Set(rows.map(r => String(r.player_id))).size;`. Upsert ONE row: `await sbUpsert(env, 'playhq_sweep_log?on_conflict=season_id,grade_id', [{ season_id: seasonId, grade_id: gradeId, competition_name: resolved.competition.name, organisation_name: resolved.organisation.name, grade_name: gradeName, player_count: count, last_swept_at: new Date().toISOString() }]);`. Keep the entire body in try/catch; it stays env-guarded via sbGet/sbUpsert and must NEVER throw into the handler. Update the doc comment to say per-(season_id, grade_id).

VERIFY sbUpsert composite on_conflict: read sbUpsert (~L2242) and confirm it builds the request URL as `${env.SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}` with `table` interpolated VERBATIM (no encodeURIComponent on `table`). So the literal comma in 'playhq_sweep_log?on_conflict=season_id,grade_id' is preserved and PostgREST resolves the two-column conflict target matching the composite PK (season_id, grade_id). Do NOT change sbUpsert; just confirm the composite target string is correct.

In the /api/admin/sweep-competition handler, update the updateSweepLog call site (~L2886) from `await updateSweepLog(env, resolved, resolved.season.id)` to `await updateSweepLog(env, resolved, resolved.season.id, gradeId, grades[gradeIndex].name)`. Keep it best-effort and in the same position (after runSweepBatch, before computing next).

Update the GET /api/sweep-log handler (~L3128): change the sbGet query to `playhq_sweep_log?select=season_id,grade_id,competition_name,organisation_name,grade_name,player_count,last_swept_at&order=competition_name.asc,grade_name.asc`. Keep it public, read-only, and Cache-Control: public, max-age=15.
Record in findings the final signatures of ingestPlayers / runSweepBatch / updateSweepLog and the exact /api/sweep-log select+order string, so FEAT-002 maps the right fields.
acceptance_criteria: ingestPlayers accepts optional gradeId/gradeName and, on the sweep path (seasonId present), stamps grade_id + grade_name onto appearance rows; the no-seasonId branch produces byte-for-byte unchanged rows with no grade keys.
runSweepBatch forwards gradeShortId as grade_id and the new gradeName to ingestPlayers.

updateSweepLog upserts ONE playhq_sweep_log row keyed on (season_id, grade_id) with a player_count that is the DISTINCT player_id count filtered by BOTH season_id and grade_id, and never throws into the handler.
GET /api/sweep-log returns season_id, grade_id, competition_name, organisation_name, grade_name, player_count, last_swept_at ordered stably.
BACKFILL_TOKEN gate, limit cap (12), resumable cursor, retryable/throttled fields are unchanged; no new env vars; no DDL; sbUpsert/sbGet/json/cors/fetchSeasonGrades signatures unchanged.
verification: From c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\.worktrees\sweep-log-grade\playhq-worker: run `npm install` if node_modules is absent.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` — expect no type errors.
Run `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run` — expect a successful bundle with NO deploy.
findings:
Implemented in playhq-worker/src/index.ts. Final signatures:
- ingestPlayers(summary: Record<string, unknown>, env: Env, seasonId?: string, gradeId?: string, gradeName?: string): Promise<void>. Sweep path (seasonId present) builds an overlay { season_id } and conditionally adds grade_id (when gradeId != null) and grade_name (when gradeName != null), spread onto each appearance row. The no-seasonId branch stays exactly `appearances` (byte-for-byte unchanged, no grade keys). Appearances upsert on_conflict=player_id,game_id unchanged.
- runSweepBatch(gradeShortId: string, offset: number, limit: number, env: Env, seasonId?: string, gradeName?: string): Promise<BackfillBatchResult>. Single ingest call is `await ingestPlayers(summary, env, seasonId, gradeShortId, gradeName)` (gradeShortId is the grade id). Throttle short-circuit and all other logic unchanged.
- updateSweepLog(env: Env, resolved: SeasonGrades, seasonId: string, gradeId: string, gradeName: string): Promise<void>. Per-(season_id, grade_id): distinct player count from sbGet `playhq_player_appearances?select=player_id&season_id=eq.${enc(seasonId)}&grade_id=eq.${enc(gradeId)}&limit=50000`, then upsert ONE row via sbUpsert to 'playhq_sweep_log?on_conflict=season_id,grade_id' with { season_id, grade_id, competition_name, organisation_name, grade_name, player_count, last_swept_at }. Whole body in try/catch, env-guarded, never throws.

Handler call sites (/api/admin/sweep-competition): runSweepBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env, resolved.season.id, grades[gradeIndex].name ?? undefined); updateSweepLog(env, resolved, resolved.season.id, gradeId, grades[gradeIndex].name ?? ""). Note: SeasonGrade.name is `string | null`, so null is coerced (?? undefined for runSweepBatch's optional param; ?? "" for updateSweepLog's required string param).

sbUpsert verified (not modified): builds URL as `${env.SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}` with table interpolated verbatim (no encodeURIComponent on table), so the literal comma in 'playhq_sweep_log?on_conflict=season_id,grade_id' is preserved and PostgREST resolves the composite (season_id, grade_id) conflict target.

GET /api/sweep-log exact query string (sbGet arg): "playhq_sweep_log?select=season_id,grade_id,competition_name,organisation_name,grade_name,player_count,last_swept_at&order=competition_name.asc,grade_name.asc". Still public, read-only, Cache-Control: public, max-age=15.

Verification (from playhq-worker): npm install (node_modules was absent) OK; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json OK (no errors); npx wrangler deploy --dry-run OK (bundled 95.62 KiB, no deploy).
